title: Continuation dispatch, the continuation cap, and settlement (Story 1.5, lane C)
summary: Third of four lanes for the frozen Story 1.5 in the kit's dispatch adapter: make a continuation run as the next cycle of the same story under the same revalidated stamp through the canonical path, consuming the continuation artifact into the prompt and the sizing estimate; refuse an expired stamp naming the central re-route path; enforce the continuation cap deterministically from retained per-cycle results with an explicit recorded PM decision to exceed it; record the continuation chain in the story record; prove settlement through the unmodified completion-watch and cleanup contracts; contract and schema updates; tests on both harnesses. Frozen launch command texts stay byte-identical; no local substitution of any routed field. Judgment calls: artifact-to-prompt shape, per-cycle result retention naming, the decision key. A wrong result would launch a continuation past its cap or substitute a route.
